gbifID.description: Unique global biodiversity record identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier linking each record to its source dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique identifier linking each Lomatium orientale observation to its iNaturalist record.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each record, always Plantae.

phylum.description: Phylum classification for the plant, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the plant, consistently Magnoliopsida.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Apiales.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the species, uniformly Apiaceae.

genus.description: Genus of the plant, consistently recorded as Lomatium.

species.description: Species name for all records, consistently Lomatium orientale.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet field is empty for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each record, consistently listed as species.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed plant, consistently Lomatium orientale J.M.Coult. & Rose.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Lomatium orientale.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is unavailable for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code of observation location, using ISO two-letter identifiers such as US and CA.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: U.S. and Canadian state or province where each observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation site.

publishingOrgKey.description: Publishing organization identifier, constant UUID for all records.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of coordinates in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision information is missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy information is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each Lomatium orientale observation.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from February (2) to October (10).

year.description: Calendar year when the observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for Lomatium orientale occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier linking each observation to its species entry in the taxonomic database.

basisOfRecord.description: All records are derived from human observations.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for observations, consistently recorded as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All entries are classified under the observations collection code.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded the species identification.

dateIdentified.description: Identification date and time of each occurrence record.

license.description: License type assigned to each occurrence record, using standard Creative Commons identifiers.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Lomatium orientale observation.

typeStatus.description: No recorded information; the field is entirely empty for all observations.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means field contains no data for any occurrence record.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when the record was last interpreted.

mediaType.description: Type of media associated with each observation, e.g., still image.

issue.description: Data quality flags noting coordinate rounding, derived continent, and missing taxon identifier.

lomatium_orientale.description: Occurrence records of Lomatium orientale observations, including taxonomy, location, date, and media metadata.
